description: This Java source file defines the immutable data class `GroupGeneralData` which encapsulates information related to groups within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes group details, associations (like clients, roles, calendars), template options, and various constructors and methods for creating and manipulating instances of group data.

classes.name: GroupGeneralData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a general group, including its properties, associations, options, and various constructors for different use cases.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a GroupGeneralData instance for importing data, given group name, members, activation and submitted dates, and related identifiers.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a minimal GroupGeneralData instance with specified group ID, account number, and name, mainly for lookup purposes.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template GroupGeneralData instance with options for center, office, staff, client, and roles.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new GroupGeneralData instance by combining an existing one with a template grouping.

methods.name: withAssociations
methods.description: Creates a new GroupGeneralData instance with provided associations like members and calendars.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new GroupGeneralData instance with specified core attributes and timeline.

methods.name: updateSelectedRole
methods.description: Returns a new GroupGeneralData instance with the specified group role selected.

methods.name: withClosureReasons
methods.description: Creates a new GroupGeneralData instance with specified closure reasons.
